defects.ground: The distractors are all three possible two-category subsets of the same three labels, each prefixed “Только”; the keyed answer alone is their complete union without that prefix. The correct choice is therefore uniquely framed as comprehensive, and the three wrong answers are uniquely framed as partial. This provides a strong avoidable presentation/test-taking cue independent of knowing Peter’s system. It does not logically prove that every uninformed player must answer correctly; no measured performance claim is made. The defect is the systematic row cue and resulting failure to demonstrate the intendedMEDIUM knowledge demand, not historical inaccuracy or a new ban on all compound answers.
